sourceNotes: 更新 Capture 品牌图标，统一近白圆角底板与视觉比例，品牌素材保留透明背景（#20）。
新增标准与手绘图标切换，选择在重启后保留，并同步到 Dock、访达与聚焦搜索使用的系统应用图标。

en: Refresh the Capture icon with a near-white rounded backplate and consistent visual proportions, while retaining transparent branding assets (#20).
Switch between standard and hand-drawn icons, preserve the choice across restarts, and synchronize the system app icon used by the Dock, Finder, and Spotlight.
